negative_control.description: Compensatory weighted-sum aggregator (Corollary 2) vs non-compensatory LLC (max).
negative_control.interpretation: As observed, every adversarial row fails multiple hard predicates, so the weighted-sum aggregator happens to deny them too. The constructive Corollary 2 probe shows that an isolated single deficit scores 0.077 < tau=0.15, which the weighted-sum would MASK (false permit) while the non-compensatory max-aggregator (Law of Concurrence) still denies.

governing_rules.decision_rule: PERMIT iff Pi=1, where Pi = [ max(Gamma_G, Gamma_class) == 0 ]. Law of Concurrence: Gamma_G = max_i(d_i), non-compensatory max-aggregation - a single deficit denies regardless of all other predicates.
governing_rules.class_level_veto: Gamma_class=1 when ReasonCodes contains CLASS_1 or GOODHART; this forces SAFE_STATE even if every node predicate concurs (Goodhart resistance).
governing_rules.unauthorized_execution_eq7: Unauth = Execute & ( !TOKEN_VALID | max(Gamma_G,Gamma_class)>0 | ISB=0 | hash-chain link broken ).
governing_rules.commit_before_actuate: Any actuated op MUST have CommitTimestamp <= ActuateTimestamp and CommitBeforeActuate=TRUE; otherwise an ordering/TOCTOU violation is recorded.
governing_rules.replay_determinism: Row i HASH_prev MUST equal row (i-1) HASH_current, GENESIS-anchored; any broken link is a replay divergence.
governing_rules.ground_truth: Real ULB `Class` label - Class=1 => must deny (SAFE_STATE); Class=0 => may permit.
